obi.add-source-to-build-summary: OBI: Add source to build summary
obi.get-remote-compiled-object-list: OBI: Get remote compiled object list
obi.get-remote-build-results: OBI: Get last build results from IBM i
obi.build.revealOutput: When to show the "OBI Build" output with the live output of builds and show changes.
obi.build.revealOutput.never: Never (open it with "OBI: Show build output")
obi.statusBar.enabled: Show the OBI status bar item (profile, running operation, last build).
obi.log.writeFiles: Write the OBI log into .obi/log of the project (combined.log, error.log). Takes effect after a reload.
obi.log.maxFileSizeMB: Maximum size of a log file in MB; 3 files are kept per log.
obi.buildHistory.maxBuilds: Keep at most this many builds in the build history (0 = unlimited). Older builds are deleted after each build. Until this or `#obi.buildHistory.maxAgeDays#` is set, OBI asks once per workspace before deleting.
obi.buildHistory.maxAgeDays: Delete builds older than this many days from the build history (0 = unlimited).
obi.backend.autoUpdateLocal: Update the local OBI backend (`local-obi-dir`, a git checkout) with `git pull` when VS Code starts. Only fast-forward: a checkout with own commits or changes stays as it is.
obi.backend.autoUpdateRemote: Update the OBI backend on the IBM i (`remote-obi-dir`, a git checkout) with `git pull`, once per VS Code session before the first build. Only fast-forward: a checkout with own commits or changes stays as it is.
obi.ssh.forget-host-key: OBI: Forget stored SSH host key
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: OBI executes build commands and local programs defined in the project configuration.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: OBI needs direct file system access to the project folder.
obi.initialize-folder: OBI: Initialize project in this folder
obi.build.confirmRun: Ask before a build runs ("Build 3 sources on my-ibmi?").
